queries.query: dot product vector error norm topk gap

assumptions.assumption: Common-dimensional real vectors and a fixed query
assumptions.evidence: Real q^T k_i in trusted task; producer explicitly holds q fixed.

assumptions.assumption: Euclidean norm (or a valid dual norm pairing)
assumptions.evidence: Task says norm but does not specify which; Euclidean interpretation is conventional and must be labeled.
Positive top-k boundary gap presupposes a nontrivial boundary; task does not literally state n or k.

assumptions.assumption: Uniform per-vector bound in first case
Mean means arithmetic mean of individual error norms

assumptions.evidence: Per-vector uniform norm bounds do not imply that global bound; REV-C08.

adoption_decisions.reason: Valid for Euclidean interpretation; independent squared-norm derivation checked.
Cross-boundary proof directly yields gap>=0.03 under uniform bounds.
No global l2 error bound supplied; warning is relevant.

limitations: No network or external source verification.
No full manuscript or venue review.
No formal theorem prover or model/performance claim.
Hashes establish content identity, not applicability.
